title: Hidden costs buyers forget when buying a condo in Singapore

scenes.headline: The price is not the price
scenes.sub: Five costs buyers forget until it is too late
scenes.narration: You budgeted for the condo. You did not budget for these five.

scenes.headline: Buyer's stamp duty
scenes.sub: Payable within 14 days of exercising the OTP
scenes.narration: Buyer's stamp duty is due within fourteen days of exercising the O-T-P. On a one point five million dollar unit that is roughly forty four thousand dollars, in cash or C-P-F.

scenes.headline: Legal and conveyancing
scenes.sub: Two and a half to four thousand, plus disbursements
scenes.narration: Legal fees run between two and a half and four thousand dollars. Disbursements sit on top of that, and most buyers only see the number at completion.

scenes.headline: The cash portion
scenes.sub: 5% must be cash. CPF cannot cover it
scenes.narration: Five percent of the purchase price has to be cash. C-P-F cannot touch that portion, and it is the number that catches upgraders out most often.

scenes.headline: Bridging the gap
scenes.sub: Timing between selling and buying costs money
scenes.narration: If your sale completes after your purchase, you need a bridging loan. For example, three months of bridging on a large sum is not a small line item.

scenes.headline: The move-in bill
scenes.sub: Renovation, furniture, agent fee, MCST deposit
scenes.narration: Then comes the move-in bill. Renovation, furniture, the agent fee and the M-C-S-T deposit all land in the same quarter.

scenes.headline: Know your real number
scenes.sub: I will send you the full cost breakdown sheet
scenes.narration: Comment the word costs and I will send you the full breakdown so you can see your real number before you commit.

Knowing your real number before you commit is the whole game.

标题：买新加坡公寓，成交价之外还要准备多少钱？

很多人只算了房价，却漏掉了同一季度会一起到账的几笔支出。

1. 买方印花税，行使购买权后14天内缴清
2. 律师费与杂费
3. 5%必须是现金，公积金不能动
4. 买卖时间差可能需要过桥贷款
5. 装修、家具、管理费押金

先算清楚真实数字，再决定要不要出手。
